
### request-to-send/clear-to-send  {.smaller}



* can't detect likely interference at sender 
<hr class="vspace" />
* idea: have receiver tell when it's okay to transmit
* sender$\rightarrow$receiver: request-to-send
* receiver$\rightarrow$sender: clear-to-send

![](/multiaccess/texfig/rts-cts-request-to-sendclear-to-send.figure.svg){width=1000px}


### overhearing clear-to-send  {.smaller}

![](/multiaccess/texfig/rts-cts-overhearing-clear-to-send.figure.svg)
 

* A can infer that B is transmitting to C
* … and for how long! 
<hr class="vspace" />
* A can avoid interfering, even if out of range of carrier-sense


### overhearing ready-to-send  {.smaller}

![](/multiaccess/texfig/rts-cts-overhearing-ready-to-send.figure.svg)
 

* if A can hear B's request-to-send…
* A should avoid sending until after B should get clear-to-send


### exercise: request-to-send advantage  {.smaller}


* assume: 

   * $1 \mu\text{s}$ request-to-send/clear-to-send messages
   * $100 \mu\text{s}$ messages sent
   * chance of collision proportional to message lengths

* exercise: effect of using RTS/CTS (versus only carrier-sense) for…
* 2 nodes transmitting to one with no hidden nodes?
* 2 nodes hidden from each other transmitting to one?
